blocks: The Leading Voice AI Purpose-Built for Restaurants
Answer every inbound call, instantly respond to guest inquiries, and automatically manage reservations – 24/7.

Drive revenue across all of your restaurant locations. Our smart system will automatically suggest available reservations at sister locations if a guest’s first choice isn’t open, so you can keep guests happy while maximizing revenue.

Power seamless, end-to-end reservation flows for your guests, 24/7. Empower guests to make, change, or cancel reservations, across multiple reservation platforms like OpenTable, Yelp, and SevenRooms, anytime.

Automatically answer all of your guests’ questions, without having to painstakingly train your AI. Our in-house Conversational Design experts have spent countless hours poring over 17 million+ guest calls to build prompts for guests’ most common questions.

Let Slang AI handle your calls exactly the way you want them to be handled. Whether it’s setting up call forwarding or telling Slang AI how you want to route VIP calls during or after business hours, we’ve got you covered with easy-to-use call scheduling.

Don’t let your calls go into a black box. Get the data you need to make smarter decisions, boost revenue across locations, and elevate the guest experience. Access insights on every conversation and reservation—see top caller topics, peak call times, answer rates, guest satisfaction, covers booked, and more. Additionally, view stack-ranked performance across your locations to consistently keep performance high across your portfolio.
Speed matters. With Slang AI, you’ll get instant alerts for everything from private event inquiries to lost items, delivered straight to your phone, so you’re always on top of guest needs.
Send real-time SMS messages to guests, including reservation confirmations, ordering links, wine lists, and more.
Easily get guest information, call summaries and call recordings

Access guest information, call summaries and call recordings, in one centralized place. No more guessing what happened on a guest call. Every interaction is fully documented so your staff has the context they need to provide exceptional service.
Use Smart Tags to Prioritize Revenue Opportunities

Slang AI’s proprietary tagging system automatically organizes outstanding guest follow-ups into an easy-to-use Priority Queue so your team focuses on the highest-value opportunities first. Add notes, mark items as resolved, and ensure no potential revenue slips through the cracks.
We’ve partnered with OpenTable, SevenRooms, Yelp, and Tripleseat to provide the best possible guest experiences.
What you see is what you get. No hidden fees. Cancel anytime.
Get up and running with Slang in days, all with the full support of our onboarding specialists.
Our Conversation Designers have analyzed over millions of calls to come up with pre-built prompts for every question a guest is most likely to ask your restaurant.
We utilized our restaurant call database to pre-train our AI, so you don’t have to. Save you and your team hours of manual training work.
Provide exceptional support for your Spanish-speaking guests. Our Spanish Concierge support was developed and tested by native Spanish speakers.
We partner with the biggest names in the business to bring you seamless integrations that empower you to get the reservation and events data you need across systems.
Built With Data Privacy in Mind

We’re built for owners and operators who are just getting started, to large hospitality groups who need to scale. Our SOC 2 Type II certification ensures enterprise-grade security, reliability, and compliance as your restaurant portfolio grows.
